prompt:
Use case: isolated industrial-equipment component reconstruction
Asset type: one standalone reusable transparent PNG component for an editable industrial process diagram.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved full-slide concept; use it for the target tower's shape, placement, view and colors. Image 2 is the earlier five-device transparent group; use it only for this tower's construction details.
Primary request: Reconstruct exactly one independent exhaust tower/stack from the references.
Subject: the upper-right exhaust tower only: a tall polished stainless cylindrical chimney with a short left-facing side inlet and bolted round flange, a small golden-yellow circular safety platform/railing around its lower-middle section, and a dark charcoal steel four-leg cross-braced support frame below. Keep all these parts physically connected as one tower assembly. The side inlet must end at a clear flange so it can later connect to an editable route.
Style/medium: polished realistic industrial concept illustration matching the source's reflective silver metal, dark structural steel, precise seams and warm gold rail highlights, viewed from slightly above in a frontal three-quarter view.
Composition/framing: show the complete tower upright and uncropped, centered on a portrait-like transparent canvas with ample padding on every side. Preserve its narrow vertical proportions; do not turn it into a wide machine.
Lighting: crisp neutral overhead highlights on the stack and soft warm reflections on the gold railing, all attached to the assembly.
Constraints: outside the single exhaust-tower assembly must be genuine transparent RGBA. Include no ground plane, common shadow, other equipment or process-route line. Its own inlet tube and structural braces may remain attached.
Avoid: heating furnace, production line, recovery vessel or pump, heat exchanger, any connector bridging to another unit, long orange/teal pipes, flow glow, arrowheads, labels, badges, text, room, paper, grid, horizon, floor, detached shadow, frame, border, watermark or cropped stack.

input_references.role: approved full-slide shape, placement and style reference

review: Agent visual review pending contact-sheet fit; one upright stack with attached side flange, safety ring and braced support; no other machine, text or shared route.
